$comment: Settings that follow the account (bipe-chat/bipe#1161). The global account data event below holds { "readReceipts": bool, "palette": id, "chatBackground": id, "mural": bool }. A device keeps a copy, and the copy of the current account applies to the whole app. Reference: syncedSettingsReconcile in tools/lib/registries.mjs. At a device's first read for an account, a value only the device has goes to the account, and readReceipts takes the more private value: off wins. After that the account's value wins, except a value the person changed on this device that has not reached the server yet. A write reads the server copy and keeps every other key, including keys this client does not know. A malformed event counts as empty.
